name: Views Flipped Table
description: Table style with rows and columns flipped.
project_description:
This module provides a views table style with rows and columns flipped. This is useful for views showing few entities with many fields, such as product comparison.
 
 The module was originally developed by nadam and infojunkie , as part of Views Hacks .

 Back to top 

 Installation
Install and enable the module in the usual way.
Configuration
Create a view using the Flipped Table style, and add all the required fields.
Customization
CSS can be customized in the same manner as a normal views table.
